title: Mixed API
errorsWhy: 401 requiresAuth: a public endpoint cannot fail authentication, so it is left off the public ping and kept on the api-key secret. 400 states nothing, so it is on every operation.

responses.description: The api key is missing or not valid.

responseHeadersWhy: The header rides EVERY response the operation lists, failures included (#1270): ping's 400, and secret's 400 and 401.

responseHeaders.description: Correlates this response with our logs.
